Q5275.reason: Prosthetic groups are cofactors tightly (often covalently) bound to an enzyme and required for its catalytic activity.

Q5277.reason: A general anti-assignment clause bars delegation of duties, not assignment of the right to payment, unless that right is specifically prohibited.

Q5278.reason: Burglary requires intent to commit a felony at entry; he entered only to party and formed the intent to steal only after he was inside.
